reason: E1 supports the use of laser cladding for TC4 and its ability to produce refined, bonded coatings. E2 shows that TiAl-based coatings with added elements (Cu) increase hardness and wear resistance on TC4, and that Ni-containing coatings (Ti2Ni phase) also improve these properties. However, no cited evidence directly supports the specific claim that Ni addition to a TiAl matrix induces solid-solution strengthening or that the coating retains corrosion resistance.
premises: Laser cladding can produce dense, metallurgically bonded coatings on TC4 with refined microstructures.
TiAl-based coatings on TC4 can significantly increase surface hardness and wear resistance.
Adding Ni to a TiAl coating can induce solid-solution strengthening and lattice distortion.
The proposed TiAlNi coating will retain TC4's lightweight and corrosion resistance.
